title: Rehabilitation and Human Services, B.S. (College of Education)
notes: University Park, single track. Built from the archived 2024-25 bulletin. Verified against the page's own printed per-term subtotals. Requirements and sequencing are byte-identical to RHS-2023.json's own real (Course-List-governed) content -- confirmed by direct row-by-row comparison of both archived pages' raw HTML tables -- except that this year's own Suggested Academic Plan table has caught up in one respect: it now displays 'CI 185 or SOC 1' explicitly in First Year Fall (2023's own plan table still showed only 'SOC 1', even though 2023's Course List already allowed CI 185 -- see RHS-2023.json's notes for that specific staleness). The plan table's other staleness relative to its own Course List persists unchanged from 2023: RHS 493 is still missing entirely from the Fourth Year Fall row (modeled here via the same 'Elective/Minor'-slot substitution used in RHS-2023.json, since RHS 493 is a real prescribed course per this page's own Course List), and the 'Supporting Course' pool label has by this year switched to the generic 'Supporting Course' text (matching the specific numbered list -- CNED 401/416/421/422, RHS 226/410/428/433, SPLED 400/461 -- already governing the requirement, unlike 2022's/2023's still-displayed old CRIM/BBH/HDFS/KINES/PSYCH/SOC department-list phrasing). RHS 100/300/301/302 sequencing (RHS 100 Year 2 Fall; RHS 300 and RHS 301 both Year 2 Spring; RHS 302 Year 3 Fall, natively concurrent with the EDPSY 101/STAT 100/STAT 200 course in the same term) matches 2022/2023, not 2026's Year-1-heavy resequencing. Total credits per the page's footer: 113-121, matching 2023 and 2026. Everything else (BIOL/ANTH/BISC natural-science alternatives, PSYCH 212/HDFS 239/EDPSY 10 alternative, PSYCH 100/270, SOC 119N, CAS 100A, ENGL 15/30H and 202A/202B, EDUC 100, core RHS course numbers/titles, post-reform Gen Ed model, 2.0 GPA entrance requirement) is byte-identical to 2023 and 2026. 'etm' marks the same gateway courses 2026 marks. No campus-availability check performed on this archived page (out of scope for a historical-year build).
